official_distribution.note: The table and distributed code are not literally identical protocols. A truncated/retried native production call can also change its default collision interval. These differences are retained, not silently reconciled.

planned_physics.constant_convention: Current PyRPMD atomic-unit conversions, explicit distributed isotope masses, unmodified legacy PES coefficients
planned_physics.channel_counting: All four methane abstraction channels are in the maximum-over-paths CV; no additional factor four.
planned_physics.bead_exchange: No nuclear permutation exchange; the four channels are chemical label-equivalent pathways.
planned_physics.constraints: None: reactive flexible C-H/H-H PES, all Cartesian atoms mobile.
planned_physics.estimator: Full-sample MBAR; Gaussian umbrella integration is a reported diagnostic, not the primary acceptance estimator.
planned_physics.sampling_thermostat: Andersen with geometric waiting times; mean 50 fs
planned_physics.thermostat_note: A declared modern sampling protocol, not the old periodic phase-dependent default. Unthermostatted children use physical RPMD masses.
planned_physics.umbrella_grid: 111 inclusive table centers, -0.05 + i/100 for i=0,...,110
planned_physics.primary_surface_rule: Use the independently published xi_star (0.999 for P1, 1.007 for P>=64) for both QTST and kappa; report the measured PMF maximum separately. Never move the surface to improve rate agreement.

pilot.purpose: Executable integration, failure, overlap, autocorrelation and throughput screen. Its short warmup and small child count cannot pass literature validation.

reference_budget_proposal.not_a_turnkey_one_shot_run: Do not send all 22.2 billion retained production CVs and 22200 replica states to dense MBAR. Sampling must be staged, and identical biases merged for analysis; bounded-memory histogram WHAM must be independently compared to MBAR and refined before primary use.

refinement_order: Keep the same physical target, grid, masses, PES and every seed. Diagnose failure before increasing budget.
First compare first/second halves and independent replicas, CH4 stretches/bends, relative orientation and bead-mode variance; increase warmup if these are nonstationary.
Predeclare a new fixed budget in a separate manifest before further sampling. Do not stop a trajectory when its rate approaches the paper value.
After equilibrium and precision pass, compare dt=0.05 fs and P=64/256 with the P=128 result; retain all controls.
Compare child plateaus over 30-50 fs; extend the same parents/momenta to 100 and then 200 fs if no plateau. A paired time-step or horizon refinement is not an independent replicate.
Check Rinf=20 and 40 bohr and surface xi_star +/-0.005 only after a converged primary estimate; full-rate invariance is assessed with matched QTST and kappa, never by reusing the original kappa.

acceptance_gates.readiness: Both primary P values need successful PES/native/static checks and complete raw evidence; pilot-only output is always unvalidated.
acceptance_gates.precision: Independent-seed Student-t 95% log-rate intervals, plus hierarchical time-block/parent-block bootstrap. Relative half-width <=2% separately for QTST and kappa, <=3% for the full rate; do not count antithetic children or paired controls as independent parents.
acceptance_gates.stationarity: Every seed reports time halves and increasing block lengths; first/second-half log QTST and kappa differences must be <=3 pooled standard errors and <=3%. Report internal-coordinate, orientation and ring-mode diagnostics, not only the one-dimensional CV.
acceptance_gates.overlap: Connected overlap across the entire 0-to-surface domain, effective endpoint support, no omitted unsupported bootstrap draw. All four channels must be represented or an exact symmetry reduction separately proved.
acceptance_gates.estimator: Same raw samples: MBAR vs independently validated histogram WHAM when needed; halving analysis bin width changes QTST <1%. Report UI difference even if UI is biased.
acceptance_gates.discretization: Paired half-dt full-rate difference <2%; P128 vs P256 full-rate difference <2% with uncertainty narrow enough to resolve 2%. P64 is a lower-order diagnostic, not a replacement for P128.
acceptance_gates.plateau: 30-50 fs plateau means stable within 2% and 3 pooled standard errors; otherwise use the preregistered longer horizons and retain all curves.
acceptance_gates.paper_comparison: Only after internal gates pass: primary point estimate within 5% of the corresponding Table 2 full rate, report relative error and own interval. The paper's about-5% statistical accuracy is not an exact confidence interval and is not an adjustable tolerance.
acceptance_gates.failure_policy: Retain every seed and every failed gate. No calibrated prefactors, PES changes, selected windows, selectively removed trajectories or target-neighbor parameter choices.

native_probe_predeclared_gates.nve_scope: Short deterministic integrator consistency check from fixed non-equilibrium starts; no equilibrium or rate claim.
